analyst.summary: Anant Raj is a Delhi-NCR real estate developer that has been building a meaningful data-center business (28 MW of capacity so far) alongside its traditional residential, commercial and hospitality projects. The company has approved a plan to separate the data-center business into its own separately listed company, which will change what current shareholders hold. The underlying business has grown well recently and the balance sheet has improved significantly over time. We rate it a Hold, but flag that the pending demerger is a major structural event investors should track closely rather than assume away.
